caption: The drawing depicts a single metal pitcher or coffee pot placed centrally on a plain light background. The pot is conical in shape, widening toward the base and tapering near the top, with a circular, slightly domed lid featuring a small knob at the center. It has a long, narrow, angular spout emerging from the upper portion of the body on the left side, and a large, rounded handle attached to the upper right side. The object is rendered in various shades of brown and bronze with subtle green patina accents, giving it an aged metallic appearance. Decorative floral and geometric engravings cover the surface of the pot in lighter and darker hues that contrast with the main bronze color. The base of the pot is wide and circular, supporting the overall structure, and the image includes the artist’s signature "CARL STREHLAU" at the bottom right.
title: Pa. German Coffee Pot
